scenes.brief: Display the Notion logo and tagline 'One workspace. Every team.' on a clean background.
Show a captured view of Notion's homepage featuring a team dashboard with tasks and databases.
Show a captured inner page illustrating Notion's universal search returning results across docs and pages.
From the homepage, navigate to and demonstrate one connected workspace for notes, docs, and projects, showing 2-3 distinct steps.
Present a call-to-action screen urging viewers to start using Notion at notion.com with the tagline.

Start using Notion today at notion.com to keep work moving 24/7.
